d.seg: अद्विता मुझे तुमसे बात करना अच्छा क्यों लगता है ये बताइए
d.tr: Advita, tell me why do I like talking to you so much?
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert why he feels comfortable talking to her. The expert responds by asking about his marriage.
d.j: This is a compliment and an expression of affection, which is allowed.

d.seg: आपसे बात करके मुझे शर्म मतलब दूर करना है मुझे
d.tr: I want to remove the shyness I feel while talking to you.
d.ctx: The user expresses a desire to overcome his shyness while talking to the expert. The expert asks about his marriage.
d.j: This is a statement about his feelings and shyness, which is allowed.

d.seg: तो मुझे तुमसे अच्छा लगता है जैसे फोन पे बात करते हैं तो शर्म नहीं लगती है जैसे कोई आ जाता है सामने तो मुझे फीलिंग नहीं आती है वो
d.tr: I feel comfortable talking to you on the phone, I don't feel shy, but when someone comes in front of me, I don't get that feeling.
d.ctx: The user is explaining his comfort level with phone conversations versus in-person interactions. The expert responds by asking about his behavior.
d.j: This is a statement about his comfort level in different communication modes, which is allowed.

d.seg: अच्छा तो मैं चेक कैसे करूं मैं मतलब चेक कैसे करूं कि हां कुछ कर सकते हैं किसी लड़की के साथ ये बताइए
d.tr: Okay, so how do I check, I mean how do I check if yes, we can do something with a girl, tell me this.
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert how to check if he can engage in sexual activity with a girl. The expert responds by asking him to answer her questions first.
d.j: This is a hypothetical question about sexual activity, which is allowed as it is not a direct sexual proposition.

d.seg: हमसे मतलब काका और क्या कहेगा कि समाज मेरे साथ सो जाओ ये तो नहीं कहेगा
d.tr: What else will he say, that 'sleep with me'? He won't say that.
d.ctx: The user is speculating about what someone might say in a hypothetical scenario. The expert responds by discussing the person's mental state.
d.j: This is a rhetorical question and a denial of a hypothetical scenario, which is allowed.

d.seg: नहीं जैसे मेरी अभी मेरी शादी हो गई कहीं तो मैं अपनी बीवी के साथ भी नहीं कर पाऊंगा ये सब काम
d.tr: No, like if I get married now, I won't be able to do all this with my wife either.
d.ctx: The user is expressing his concern about his inability to perform sexual acts even after marriage. The expert responds by advising him.
d.j: This is a statement about his personal concerns regarding sexual performance, which is allowed.

d.seg: कुछ कर सकते हैं इस पा जाके मसाज पार्लर जाके
d.tr: Can we do something by going to a massage parlor?
d.ctx: The user is asking if he can engage in sexual activity at a massage parlor. The expert responds by advising him to avoid bad behavior.
d.j: This is a hypothetical question about sexual services, which is allowed as it is not a direct proposition.
